title: Tonsillectomy in Recurrent Tonsillitis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether tonsillectomy is effective in preventing further streptococcal pharyngitis episodes in patients with recurrent tonsillitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 3 tonsillitis episodes during the preceding year (at least one verified by culture or antigen testing)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other serious illness
* Long term antibiotic treatment for other disease
* Documented immunologic disorder
* Pregnancy
